about: Official Python documentation (docs.python.org, a static Sphinx site). The CLI fetches the glossary as JSON, the module index, the general index by letter, tables of contents, What's New highlights, doc pages, the API entries on a page, and documentation downloads, for any docs version.

commands.summary: Get every Python glossary term with its HTML definition, as a JSON object keyed by term

params.name: version
params.description: Docs version: '3' (latest stable) or a specific version such as '3.12' or '3.13'

commands.summary: List all standard-library modules from the Python Module Index, with descriptions and doc links
List general index entries (functions, classes, keywords, topics) that start with a given letter, with links to where each is documented

params.name: letter
params.description: Uppercase index letter A-Z, or 'Symbols' or '_'

commands.summary: List the table of contents (chapters and pages) of a docs section such as the library reference, tutorial, HOWTOs, language reference or What's New
Get a documentation page (module reference, tutorial chapter, HOWTO, What's New) with its title, breadcrumb, source link and full text

params.name: section
params.description: Docs section directory, e.g. library, tutorial, howto, reference, whatsnew, builtins

commands.summary: List the API objects (functions, classes, methods, attributes, exceptions, data) documented on a page, each with signature, anchor and first description paragraph
Get the 'Summary – Release highlights' bullet points from a Python release's What's New page

params.name: version
params.description: Docs version to read from: '3' (latest) or e.g. '3.12'

commands.summary: List downloadable documentation archives (PDF, HTML, plain text, EPUB) for a docs version
